messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 429 rate and queue growth on Dedicated pool `dedicated-eu-3`. CPU and GPU workers saturated. 5m error rate: 18% (baseline 0.3%). Affected customers: cust-alpha, cust-beta. Paging eng-oncall.

samantha (oncall): acked. looking now. any upstream deploys? :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy `model-server:v3.12.1` to eu cluster finished 6m ago (ci/rollout/9821) — no rollout failures reported.

matt (eng-platform): i see increased qps from cust-alpha on /v1/generate with very long context sizes. KV cache miss rate jumped. autoscaler has hit max_replicas=12 for dedicated-eu-3.

samantha (oncall): ok — sounds like autoscaler ceiling. can we temporarily enable burst capacity and raise max_replicas? what's the risk to other pools?

vivian (infra): we can toggle burst capacity (adds up to 4 extra ephemeral replicas for 10m) and bump max_replicas to 20. risk: short-term higher infra spend and higher GPU contention in eu region. network & storage ok. recommend sequence: 1) enable burst, 2) increase max_replicas, 3) adjust per-customer quotas if still overloaded.

samantha (oncall): run the commands please and share outputs so i can mark mitigation in the incident timeline.

vivian (infra): running now.

vivian (infra): ```
# enable burst capacity for pool
redwoodctl dedicated update --pool dedicated-eu-3 --burst-capacity enable --burst-size 4 --burst-duration 600
# increase autoscaler upper bound
redwoodctl dedicated autoscale set --pool dedicated-eu-3 --max-replicas 20
``` 

vivian (infra): command outputs:
```
[ok] burst-capacity enabled for dedicated-eu-3 (size=4 duration=600s)
[ok] autoscaler max_replicas updated: 12 -> 20
``` 

samantha (oncall): thanks. watching metrics. @matt can you trigger a gradual traffic shift to relieve overloaded nodes (traffic shaping) — prefer prefix hashing move rather than global reroute.

matt (eng-platform): initiating graceful rebalancing across pool nodes — using routing weight adjustments. command:
```
redwoodctl route adjust --pool dedicated-eu-3 --strategy redirect-hash --gradual 30s
```

matt (eng-platform): started. expected propagation ~2min.

(2m later)

samantha (oncall): metrics: 429 rate down to 6%, tail latency improving. KV cache warmup in progress. cust-alpha successful requests trending up. still seeing throttles for cust-beta.

kevin (cs): on call with cust-beta now. They're seeing spikes when they send long-batched requests. asking for temporary quota bump while they throttle their client.

samantha (oncall): we can do targeted quota change for cust-beta. matt — can you increase per-minute token allowance by 2x for them for 20m? then revert.

matt (eng-platform): yes. applying targeted quota change.

matt (eng-platform): ```
redwoodctl customers quota update --customer cust-beta --rate-per-minute 2000 --duration 1200
```

matt (eng-platform): applied. note: this will consume additional capacity; watch for any new hotspots.

samantha (oncall): monitoring — overall error rate now 1.8%. tail p95 latency down to baseline. marking mitigation: burst enabled + autoscaler increased + routing adjusted + cust-beta quota bump.

samantha (oncall): @kevin please let cust-beta know the temporary bump and advise them to implement client-side backoff and smaller batch sizes. also ask for logs of their spike times.

kevin (cs): on it. i'll confirm once they switch to smaller batches.

samantha (oncall): handing off — my shift ends in 25m. @matt @vivian please keep watch for 30m while autoscaler cools down and burst timers expire. I'll leave runbook steps here:
- check dedicated-eu-3 replica count and GPU utilization
- watch per-customer 429s and token burn rates
- if error rate climbs >5% revert cust-beta quota and enable stricter per-customer rate limits
- if autoscaler oscillates, set cooldown to 120s and lower scale_step

samantha (oncall): brief status: incident mitigated, customer impact reduced to partial for cust-beta (they have temp quota); root cause likely sudden customer workload pattern with long contexts + cache miss. next: investigation ticket assigned to eng-ml for KV cache warmup improvements and autoscaler tuning.

matt (eng-platform): ack. i'll monitor autoscaler and remove the quota bump after 20m or earlier if stable. assigning followups: CORE-4532 (autoscale policy), CORE-4533 (per-customer pacing middleware).

vivian (infra): i'll watch infra spend alerts and make sure burst capacity autosets back off. setting alert: if ephemeral replicas >3 for >12m notify pager.

samantha (oncall): thanks team. closing page but keeping thread open for handoff notes. :white_check_mark:

(30m later)

matt (eng-platform): follow-up: quota bump reverted for cust-beta at 1742110876, metrics steady. autoscaler scaled down to 12 replicas, burst expired. incident resolved — filing post-incident summary.

incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-2145. Severity: S2. Mitigations: burst_enabled, max_replicas_increased, routing_rebalance, temp_quota_bump. Followups: CORE-4532, CORE-4533, ENG-ops spend alert review.
